summary: Ice climber buried and killed by avalanche/icefall in the Uncompahgre Gorge, Ouray; guide and clients attempted rescue; Ouray Mountain Rescue recovered body.
notes: Guide plus three clients; one killed, one hit but uninjured. Run 729: merged kool1079.com corroboration (Ouray County SO DocumentCenter chunk). 2026-09-20: merged OMRT FB post permalink (2020-01-23 OMRT post sharing the CAIC final report on the January 18, 2020 accident; match).
